Ixodes parameter analysis (Φ, θ, β)

Neo Chatterjee

2026-05-12

This document contains three diagnostic tests of every parameter (Φ, θ, β) and covariate (LAI, NDVI, EVI) combination:

  • (1): Simple regression of the most recent parameter estimate against a time-averaged covariate; table of R^2, p-values, and significance tacked onto the end for convenience
  • (2): Frequency distribution of R^2 for regressions of 1000 simulated (based on mean and SD and assuming normality) parameter values against a time-averaged covariate
  • (3): Sensitivity analysis

TEST 1 - SIMPLE REGRESSION
